data.reason_zh: 摘要提出用评估反馈训练选择器，并保留已评估节点档案来选择父代继续扩展脚手架，符合多轮自改进方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split
scope_support.object_quote: A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Huxley-Gödel Machine selection draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the steering counts of nodes that have already been evaluated, and it expands the child that parent proposes.
